AccessGrantBody.title: AccessGrantBody
AccessGrantBody.description:
Requirement 29.7's grant: an Investigation purpose, and a matter naming the
investigation -- the review entry id, or a 1-2000 character description. Exactly one
of the two.

CallbackOutcome.title: CallbackOutcome
CallbackOutcome.description:
The callback outcome for the web app: either the session is open, or the person must
complete the web-only registration first.

CommentBody.title: CommentBody
CommentBody.description: The Owner_Comment's text (Requirement 17.3's free text, at most 5000 characters).

ConfirmBody.title: ConfirmBody
ConfirmBody.description:
Requirement 15.8's Report language selection, and the price quote the Model_Owner
confirmed (Requirement 6.4: a Paid_Tier confirmation cites the quote that displayed
the price).

CreateSubmissionBody.title: CreateSubmissionBody
CreateSubmissionBody.description:
Requirement 27.1's pre-upload confirmation: the model's name, its licence, the
right to submit it, and exactly one Track (Requirement 4.1).

CreatedTokenResponse.title: CreatedTokenResponse
CreatedTokenResponse.description: The one-time response that shows the secret (Requirement 32.2).

HubChatGrantBody.title: HubChatGrantBody
HubChatGrantBody.description: Requirement 29.9's Hub_Chat conversation grant: a purpose only, never a matter.

PreCreateBody.title: PreCreateBody
PreCreateBody.description:
The tusd hook's own view of one upload about to start: the tus metadata this
service defined (``role``, ``path``, ``sha256``, the Submission id), and the
declared ``Upload-Length`` the design requires (a deferred length is refused).

PublicationBody.title: PublicationBody
PublicationBody.description:
Requirement 18.4's own answer: whether the Report link is published with the entry
(Requirement 18.5).

RegistrationBody.title: RegistrationBody
RegistrationBody.description:
The web-only registration form (Requirement 1.5): the Model_Owner display name and
the Interface language, as the person entered them.

SignInStarted.title: SignInStarted
SignInStarted.description: The sign-in response: where the web app must send the browser.

TrackSettingsBody.title: TrackSettingsBody
TrackSettingsBody.description:
The Season Track settings of the design's Season component, as the Season starts
consuming them: the Judge_Version for grading, the Task_Set_Versions in order, the
generation settings, the repetition rule, the answer normalisation, the aggregation
method, and the Report length limit.

WhoAmI.title: WhoAmI
WhoAmI.description: What the session currently is: the identity every other route will authorize.
